p: Hale Top is part of Wythenshawe's civic centre, the shopping and services hub of this big south Manchester estate. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, open only to over 18s.

Wythenshawe Park is the big draw locally, with acres of open space, a horticultural centre, a community farm and Wythenshawe Hall, a Tudor timber-framed house. The Forum, close to the civic centre, has the library, a leisure centre and a pool. Manchester Airport is just down the road, and the Metrolink airport line runs through Wythenshawe, so it's easy to get into the city or head out for a spot of plane-watching at the airport's viewing areas.
